body:
> Eod · 2026-09-26

Source: `C:\TAG Marketing Claude\Summit Plumbing Pros\EOD Report 2026-09-26.txt`

Two reports for this date (the Pipeliners file says Friday, the Summit file says Saturday).

# Pipeliners
File: `Pipeliners\reports\eod-2026-09-26.md`. See [Pipeliners (Hub)](lib:brain-pipeliners-hub).
- Buckeye, Maricopa and cast iron audit: Google has not recrawled Buckeye since Aug 28, so the Aug 31, Sep 1 and Sep 15 edits are not indexed yet; any test clock should start at recrawl. Buckeye and Maricopa took paid pMax impressions, so they were left untouched (rule: no edits to pages that run ads).
- 124 queries at positions 8 to 26; non-ad pages are already optimized, so the gap is recrawl, not content. Recommendation: request indexing rather than keep editing.
- Cast iron post rewritten: new H2s and H3, repair options section, unsourced "25 to 40 years" softened to "decades sooner", caliche wording, 3 new internal links. Review Oct 24.
- /gold-canyon/ rewritten around "sewer line replacement in Gold Canyon, AZ" with a new section, an unsupported claim removed, and its first in-content link from Superior. Review Oct 24.
- Service page checks: all 15 have canonical, OG and one H1; short metas without CTA, an H3 to H5 skip, no WebP. Deeper check: only 3 of 12 are genuinely distinct; leak detection page was 79% copied from drain lining.
- Leak detection page rewritten for "leak detection in Phoenix" (292/mo, KD 5): 637 to 1,164 original words, method section, FAQ schema, 3 [Higgsfield](lib:brain-higgsfield) images, bullet rendering bug fixed, OTTO Service schema rewritten.
- Added Article schema to 2 posts via a small opt-in plugin; rewrote metas on /trenchless-sewer-repair/ and /epoxy-pipe-lining/ with a CTA.
- Indexing requested for 6 URLs; leak detection page failed (Chrome login lacked access to that GSC property).

# Summit Plumbing Pros AZ
File: `Summit Plumbing Pros\EOD Report 2026-09-26.txt`. See [Summit Plumbing Pros AZ (Hub)](lib:brain-summit-plumbing-pros-az-hub).
- Rewrote 8 near-duplicate city pages (73 to 97% similar) with unique local copy and new titles/descriptions; unbacked claims removed.
- City hub "Related Services" buttons now point to each city's own 11 service pages: 110 new city links.
- Heading fixes: wrong "Schedule your pipe lining today" on 8 pages, city case in 18 headings, duplicate boxes on 9 water pressure pages, Mesa sewer heading order.
- Replaced unapproved "Gas Line Installation" with Water Softener Installation on the installation page.
- Published "water softener maintenance checklist" (14,800 searches/month, low difficulty) with FAQ schema and links from 2 related posts. Tracker now 202 pages.

# Follow-ups
- Pipeliners: fix GSC access and request indexing for the leak detection page; Scott to confirm warranty, "50+ year", "same day" and "licensed ePIPE partners" claims and supply 2 to 3 real job photos; check Last Crawl Oct 1 to 3; reviews Oct 24. Search Atlas keyword quota (2,000) used up.
- Summit: request indexing for the new post and 8 rewrites; Kim's call on emergency, "Fast Response" and "Same-Day" boxes, the Orangeburg page claims, and softener page claims; Oct 2, 10 and 24 checks.
